headline: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $44 Billion All-Stock Deal
summary: Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $43.9 billion. The merger aims to bolster capabilities against AI-driven cyber threats.
why: Consolidation in the cybersecurity sector is accelerating as companies seek to integrate AI-powered security tools to defend against increasingly sophisticated digital attacks.
